title: The ground truth fails its own verifier: circular debt schedule recalculates to different values
evidence: I ran verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells with gt_07_golden.xlsx as the output. The verifier forces a LibreOffice recalculation, and the ground truth scored 0.0: 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9837. 17 cell error(s): Modification error at LBO & Lenders!T50: answer=-7.49437449150413, output=-7.25996975435565; U50: answer=-9.027, output=-8.298; V50: answer=-11.042, output=-9.531; V53: answer=115.42, output=116.93; V57: answer=115.42, output=116.93 ...'. The cause is a circular reference in the LBO debt schedule: amortization row 50 is '=S53-S52', interest row 53 is '=S54*AVERAGE(S49,S51)', and ending balance row 51 is '=SUM(S49:S50)'. The workbook depends on iterative calculation (calcPr iterate="true" iterateCount="100" iterateDelta="0.0001"). The cached Excel values in the ground truth differ from LibreOffice's iterated result by more than the 1% tolerance. The verifier passes only when every modification cell matches, and this is the only verifier (weight 1). A perfect answer therefore scores 0, so the problem cannot be passed.
confirmation: 'LBO & Lenders' rows 49-54 form a circular schedule (X50 '=X53-X52', X51 '=SUM(X49:X50)', X53 '=X54*AVERAGE(X49,X51)') under calcPr iterate=true, and the golden caches are not converged (X53 cached 109.64 vs 113.36 from cached inputs), so the LibreOffice-recalculated golden cannot match its own Exce

title: The golden workbook fails its own mandatory recalculation and grading
evidence: The verifier forcibly recalculates submissions with LibreOffice but compares them against unrecalculated golden caches. Passing gt_07_golden.xlsx through that same recalculation produced 17 grading errors: regression ratio 1.0000 and modification ratio 0.9837, which yields zero on the sole verifier (weight 1). For example, 'LBO & Lenders'!X50 is cached as -16.8263732189333 but recalculates to -12.7810638582942. The golden caches are internally inconsistent: X53 contains =X54*AVERAGE(X49,X51), whose cached inputs give 113.35963381484534, not its cached result 109.6382395757. The circular debt schedule therefore makes even the supplied expected workbook fail.
confirmation: Verified the cited inconsistency: golden X53 caches 109.6382395757 while 0.1275*AVERAGE(897.508,880.682) = 113.3596, so the cached circular values are not a fixed point and forced recalculation of the golden itself yields modification errors on the sole all-or-nothing verifier.
